paper_id: PACE_ Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model__oa_W4402669970
title: PACE: Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model
motivation: 人类编写prompt质量参差不齐,且提升prompt需要大量人工努力和专业知识
problem_framing: 将prompt视为policy,利用actor-critic框架将prompt优化形式化为迭代反馈过程
key_insight: 让LLM同时扮演actor和critic双重角色,actor执行prompt产生响应,critic评估响应反馈批评,从而实现真实反馈驱动的prompt改进
method_signature: PACE通过actor-critic范式和迭代算法,使用n个actor执行prompt和n个critic评估响应,聚合反馈后更新prompt
evaluation_criteria: 在Instruction Induction和Big-Bench上测试,对比W-HWP/M-HWP/B-HWP/Butter Fingers/Ape等多种初始prompt下的性能提升
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: PACE在处理中低难度问题上高效,但面对高度复杂问题时,需要人机协作才能发挥更大潜力
evidence_for_taste: critic possesses a slightly higher significance
humans can often produce a satisfactory first attempt without much effort
The real challenge is refining and optimizing these drafts
thinking_moves: 从强化学习actor-critic算法获得灵感,迁移到prompt工程领域
把prompt重新定义为policy,把LLM同时作为执行者和评估者
通过迭代反馈循环而非一次性生成来优化prompt质量
cites_own_work: Self-collaboration code generation via chatgpt (Dong et al., 2023a)
